description:
The image depicts a serene scene of an elephant standing in the water, accompanied by two smaller elephants in the background. The dominant elephant, situated in the center of the image, faces the left side of the frame. Its trunk is extended downward, touching the water, while its ears are spread wide and slightly tilted backward. The elephant's wrinkled gray skin has a rough texture, and its tail hangs down behind it.

In the background, two smaller elephants are visible. One is lying on its back
